Key points I captured from the call:
- Expected steady-state: 800M tokens/month (inference tokens consumed), with burst peaks up to ~1.8B tokens in heavy months.
- Typical generation workload: avg sequence ~512 tokens, model family similar to a 70B dense/quantized variant.
- Concurrency target: 30–45 concurrent streams during peak windows.
- 95th percentile latency requirement: <250ms for tail requests.
- Initial pilot ask: reserved capacity to support a sustained 95th percentile throughput of ~80k tokens/sec with headroom for short bursts.

Budget & unit-econ notes from your team (please confirm):
- Target unit cost target you mentioned: $120 / 1M tokens (target), with an acceptable budget range of $100–$200 / 1M tokens depending on term and commitments.
- Procurement prefers a single PO for a 3-month pilot, then evaluation for 12–24 month reserved commitment if numbers look good.

Questions for you to confirm:
1) Is the 800M tokens/month steady-state our conservative baseline (yes/no)?
2) Do you have a strict required contract term minimum for the pilot PO (3 months vs 6 months)?

Next internal steps on our side: we will run a quick sizing exercise (GPU count + families) + a unit-econ model to show price bands for H100 vs A100 vs L40s equivalency and share recommended pilot configuration by Monday. If you confirm the baseline numbers above, I can include a 3-month cost proposal and benchmark plan.

Morning — quick sizing + price bands based on our most conservative runtime assumptions. Numbers assume model is a 70B-class quantized transformer, avg seq 512, effective tokens/sec per GPU measured with Redwood runtime (batching + prefix cache)

Sizing (sustained 95p throughput target: 80k tokens/sec)
- H100 (full precision optim): ~22k tokens/sec per GPU => recommend 4x H100 (88k tokens/sec sustained) with 10–15% headroom for concurrency variability.
- A100 (dense 80GB): ~13k tokens/sec per GPU => recommend 6x A100 (78k tokens/sec sustained) — slightly under target so prefer 7x A100 for headroom.
- L40s (cost-optimized inference): ~16k tokens/sec per GPU => recommend 5x L40s (80k tokens/sec).

Pilot config recommendation: 4x H100 (preferred for tail latency/headroom) with burstable extra slot (1x L40s) for spike handling during bench.

Unit-econ (illustrative) — includes reserved infra amortization, expected batching efficiency, and estimated ops/support overheads:
Assumptions: 800M tokens/month baseline, 30% effective batching/kv cache savings, infra amortized over term, maintenance/support 8% of invoice.
- 3-month pilot (3-month infra amortization premium):
  * 4x H100 pilot list cost (infra + ops): $65k/month
  * Convert to $/1M tokens at 800M baseline: $81 / 1M tokens (pilot premium).
  * At 1.2B tokens/month: $54 / 1M tokens.
- 12-month committed pricing (amortized, reserved discount applied):
  * 4x H100 reserved: $38k/month
  * At 800M tokens/month => $47.5 / 1M tokens
  * At 1.2B tokens/month => $31.7 / 1M tokens

Important: the above raw infra-only math does not include enterprise add-ons (longer retention, extra observability retention, premium SLA). If Asha's procurement target is $120 / 1M, we have plenty of headroom to add those enterprise items and still be competitive for a 12-month commitment.

Concrete next steps I suggest:
1) Send Asha a 3-month pilot quote for 4x H100 including benchmark window and acceptance criteria (we price pilot at $65k/mo list, with a credit if they convert to 12-month reservation within 30 days).
2) Rishi: propose a load script (500 concurrent threads ramping to 45, 95th latency instrumentation) and two short benchmark days (warmup + steady-state).
3) Marissa/Kim: I'll draft a term sheet (pilot PO terms, conversion credit, payment terms).

I can have the pilot quote + term sheet draft ready today if procurement wants the PO.
